name: Charlotte Linlin
effect:
[On Play] You may trash 1 card from your hand: Your opponent chooses one:
• Your opponent trashes 2 cards from their hand.
• Trash 1 card from the top of your opponent's Life cards.

official_faq.question: If I activate this [On Play] effect and my opponent chooses "Your opponent trashes 2 cards from their hand", which player trashes 2 cards from their hand?
official_faq.answer: The player who did not activate this [On Play] effect will choose 2 cards from their hand and place them in their trash.

official_faq.question: If I activate this [On Play] effect and my opponent chooses "Trash 1 card from the top of your opponent's Life cards", which player trashes 1 card from their Life cards?
official_faq.answer: The player who did not activate this [On Play] effect will trash 1 card from the top of their Life cards.

official_faq.question: I activated this [On Play] effect when my opponent had no Life cards, and trashed 1 card from my hand. Can my opponent still choose "Trash 1 card from the top of your opponent's Life cards"?
official_faq.answer: Yes, they can. In this case, nothing will happen as they have no Life cards to trash.
